<!--
Corrections are the most valuable issue type here. A wrong CLI flag or a retired
exam code costs more credibility than a missing skill, so being shown one is the
system working.

Do not include tenant URLs, GUIDs, tokens or customer names in the output you
paste. Redact them.
-->

## Where

File path, or the skill name.

## What it says

Quote the claim as written.

## What is actually true

And how you know - a `learn.microsoft.com` link, a CLI transcript, or the
behaviour you observed. "The docs used to say this and now say that" is a
complete answer.

## Verified on

The date you checked. Skills carry a `verified_on` date, and a correction resets
the clock rather than just fixing the sentence.
